test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'TIGER' is written as 'VKIGT' and 'LION' is written as 'NKQP'. How will 'FOX' be written as in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c5c942bdefa06e9d0fda44684c03b992ed7ae8cea33bfb4425e76e5c9e8fee1b.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'TIGER' is written as 'VKIGT'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/984e2262161c7618e8f47d4520cf4d57cb9aa8c23f6408fba3096a66dd2647a0.png] 

'LION' is written as 'NKQP'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/921884a59e4e25e1749620fec735cdff39ccb2d4a04249e96b7c1dd5f32fdbc0.png] 

Similarly, 'FOX' will be written:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecf24280117864a3f01d813f0c3e43103d47421a6c87ae69f1417c0bbb436240.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"HQZ".**
